scientific_integrity: Analytical finite-point-process convergence, conditional Poisson approximation and multivariate triangular-array CLT; finite checker supports but does not establish asymptotic claims.
scientific_limitations: Only the soft attachment mechanism with degree exponent zero and fixed nonempty founder communities is treated.
The limiting forest records whether an A birth attaches to a B parent but not which B vertex.
The published-literature comparison has residual priority risk; no independent validation has been performed.
title: A Poisson–forest homophily window in rare-community recursive attachment
